ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT made as of this 8h day of January, 2018 (this “Agreement"), by and between 1619 BROADWAY REALTY LLC, a Delaware limited liability company having an office c/o Brookfield Real Estate Financial Partners, LLC, 250 Vesey Street, 15th Floor, New York, New York 10281-1023 ("Qwner"), and THE SHUBERT ORGANIZATION, INC., a New York corporation having an office at 234 West 44th Street, New York,New York 10036("TSO";and collectively with Owner, the RECITALS: WHEREAS, Owner is the fee owner of certain land known by the street address of 1619 Broadway NewYork,New York, also known as Tax Lot 19 in Block 1021 on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork, County of New York, more particularly described in Exhibit “A" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Owner_ Land"; the building and improvements located thereon are herein referred to as the “Owner Building"; and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein collectively referred to as the“Owner Parcel"); WHEREAS,TSO is the fee owner of certainland adjacent to the OwnerParcel,known by the street address 215 West 49" Street, New York, New York, also known as Tax Lot 15 in Block 1021 on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork,County of NewYork,more particularly described in Exhibit "B" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “TSO Land"; the building and improvements located thereon are herein referred to as the“Existing TSO Building"); WHEREAS,there are Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) appurtenant to Owner Parcel which are not used in the Owner Building as of the date hereof and are available for transfer to the TSO Parcel (as hereinafter defined) for use in any enlargement or alteration of the Existing TSO Building and/or construction of a TSO Building (all or a portion of which may be on anAdditional Parcel (as hereinafter defined); theExisting TSO Building and anyRebuilding of theExisting TSO Building or construction of a new building on the TSO Parcel, together, the “TSO Building:” and the TSO Land and the TSO Building are herein collectively referred to as the “TSO Parcel"); WHEREAS, by execution as of the date hereof and contemporaneously herewith of a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions in the form annexed hereto as Exhibit“C" (the “Declaration"),Owner and TSOhave utilized the procedure availablepursuant toSection12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined) to combine the Owner Land and the TSO Land so as to create a single zoning lot (as defined in the Zoning Resolution; as the same may be enlarged in accordance with the terms of this Agreement,the“Combined Zoning Lot")for the purpose of making available to TSO the Excess Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) for incorporation into and use on TSO Parcel;
